description: This file defines the DateTime class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace. It contains various static methods for date and time calculations and conversions, many of which are deprecated in favor of newer methods in other helper classes. The class provides functions for leap year checking, getting current date/time, date creation, extracting date parts, and date calculations like adding months or finding the last day of a month, among others.

classes.name: DateTime
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various date and time operations, many of which are deprecated in favor of newer helper classes.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Checks if a given year is a leap year, delegating to Helpers::isLeapYear.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Converts a date value to an Excel serial or string, delegating to Helpers::getDateValue.

methods.name: DATETIMENOW
methods.description: Returns the current date and time, delegating to Current::now.

methods.name: DATENOW
methods.description: Returns the current date, delegating to Current::today.

methods.name: DATE
methods.description: Creates a date from year, month, and day, delegating to Date::fromYMD.

methods.name: TIME
methods.description: Creates a time from hour, minute, and second, delegating to Time::fromHMS.

methods.name: DATEVALUE
methods.description: Converts a date string to a date serial, delegating to DateValue::fromString.

methods.name: TIMEVALUE
methods.description: Converts a time string to a date serial, delegating to TimeValue::fromString.

methods.name: DATEDIF
methods.description: Calculates interval between two dates, delegating to Difference::interval.

methods.name: DAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days between two dates, delegating to Days::between.

methods.name: DAYS360
methods.description: Calculates days between two dates based on a 360-day year, delegating to Days360::between.

methods.name: YEARFRAC
methods.description: Calculates the fractional year between two dates, delegating to YearFrac::fraction.

methods.name: NETWORKDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of working days between dates, delegating to NetworkDays::count.

methods.name: WORKDAY
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding or subtracting working days, delegating to WorkDay::date.

methods.name: DAYOFMONTH
methods.description: Returns the day of the month, delegating to DateParts::day.

methods.name: WEEKDAY
methods.description: Returns the day of the week, delegating to Week::day.

methods.name: WEEKNUM
methods.description: Returns the week number of the year, delegating to Week::number.

methods.name: ISOWEEKNUM
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number, delegating to Week::isoWeekNumber.

methods.name: MONTHOFYEAR
methods.description: Returns the month of a date, delegating to DateParts::month.

methods.name: YEAR
methods.description: Returns the year of a date, delegating to DateParts::year.

methods.name: HOUROFDAY
methods.description: Returns the hour component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::hour.

methods.name: MINUTE
methods.description: Returns the minute component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::minute.

methods.name: SECOND
methods.description: Returns the second component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::second.

methods.name: EDATE
methods.description: Calculates a date offset by a number of months, delegating to Month::adjust.

methods.name: EOMONTH
methods.description: Calculates the last day of a month after adding months, delegating to Month::lastDay.
